rules.title: Housing discrimination ban including source of income (FEHA)
rules.requirement: Owners of housing accommodations may not discriminate against or harass any person because of protected characteristics, including source of income, disability, familial status, and veteran or military status. Source of income includes lawful, verifiable income such as public assistance and housing subsidies, including Section 8 vouchers and HUD Veterans Affairs Supportive Housing vouchers.
rules.coverage_text: Owners of any housing accommodation in California.
rules.exemptions: It is not discrimination based on source of income to make a written or oral inquiry concerning the level or source of income.
rules.quoted_span: (a) For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.

rules.title: Ban on inquiries into protected characteristics of applicants
rules.requirement: Owners may not make or cause to be made any written or oral inquiry concerning the protected characteristics of any person seeking to purchase, rent, or lease housing. Inquiries about the level or source of income are not source-of-income discrimination.
rules.coverage_text: Owners of any housing accommodation, as to persons seeking to purchase, rent, or lease housing.
rules.exemptions: It shall not constitute discrimination based on source of income to make a written or oral inquiry concerning the level or source of income.
rules.quoted_span: (b) For the owner of any housing accommodation to make or to cause to be made any written or oral inquiry concerning the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of any person

rules.title: Aggregate income standard for co-residents
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to use a financial or income standard in the rental of housing that fails to account for the aggregate income of persons residing or proposing to reside together on the same basis as married persons.
rules.quoted_span: (n) To use a financial or income standard in the rental of housing that fails to account for the aggregate income of persons residing together or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income

rules.title: Income standard based on tenant's portion of rent where government rent subsidy
rules.requirement: Where there is a government rent subsidy, it is unlawful to use a financial or income standard in assessing rental eligibility that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.
rules.coverage_text: Rental housing applications in instances in which there is a government rent subsidy.
rules.exemptions: Does not limit the ability of the owner to request information or documentation to verify employment, to request landlord references, or to verify the identity of a person.
rules.quoted_span: (A) Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.

rules.title: Credit history alternative evidence option where government rent subsidy
rules.requirement: Where there is a government rent subsidy, a housing provider may not use an applicant's credit history without offering the option to provide lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of ability to pay the tenant's portion of rent (such as government benefit payments, pay records, and bank statements). If the applicant elects to do so, the provider must give reasonable time to respond and reasonably consider that evidence in lieu of credit history.
rules.coverage_text: Rental housing applications in instances in which there is a government rent subsidy.
rules.exemptions: Does not limit the ability of the owner to request information or documentation to verify employment, to request landlord references, or to verify the identity of a person.
rules.quoted_span: (II) Reasonably consider that alternative evidence in lieu of the person’s credit history in determining whether to offer the rental accommodation to the applicant.
